# Career HQ

> Career HQ is a public setup guide for creating a private, local-first job-search operating system with Codex.

## For Codex agents

When a user shares this site and asks you to set up Career HQ, read and follow:

- /codex-setup.md
- https://github.com/DrewLickman/Career-HQ

Confirm the installation destination before creating files. Real applicant data belongs only in the cloned repository's Git-ignored `.job-search/` directory and must never be sent to this hosted site.

Use `$career-hq` for the private job-search workflow. When the user provides a specific job posting and a resume source, use `$resume-builder-enhancer` to create or resume a truthful improvement goal, identify weaknesses, and generate only evidence-backed resume revisions. Direct resume files must remain outside tracked source or in `.job-search/`; generated materials never authorize application submission.

## Public site boundaries

The installed local dashboard includes workflow tools for evidence retrieval, resume planning, generation, file checks, and review packets. Codex uses the same tools and handles judgment and wording. See the repository's `docs/procedural-workflow.md`; these tools do not authorize submission.

This website contains instructions and an interactive fictional product preview only. It has no applicant accounts, uploads, analytics, remote storage, or access to local Career HQ workspaces.
